about_the_game: The music for the game was created before the game creation process and also during it. It is beyond genre, but loosely refers to the magical atmosphere of the game. A mix of synthesis, effects and samples. Nothing on the input equals what is on the output. Just simply a cheap experimental construct of electronic music.
